title: The Story Waited until You Were in the Room

moral: Noticing who helped, and helping back, keeps a home kind.
summary: At a bedroom with the hall light still on, Cosima notices that Grandma Nia has already taken care of a story's beginning waited until you were in the room. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Cosima does one useful thing Grandma Nia did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
